_meta.title: v2 record schema — adds mechanism role, perturbation direction, class 12, neural sub-axes
_meta.supersedes: SCHEMA.json (v1), which is preserved unchanged as the record of v1 scoring
unchanged_from_v1: three-valued coverage: TESTED_POSITIVE / TESTED_NEGATIVE / NOT_TESTED, identical meaning
evidence grades E-A..E-F and the SUGGESTED rule for E-E/E-F
coverage_denominator and its mandatory use in every derived proportion
chain recording with inferred steps scoring no cell

row_record._state_production_rule: A PHYSICALLY_IMPOSED row should carry no PRODUCES_STATE role. If one appears, either the row classification or the role assignment is wrong; the validator flags it.

v1_migration.source_row_file: string — the v1 file this row was migrated from
cells_changed: string — human-readable description of each change and its cause
new_evidence_added: string — evidence NOT present in v1, discovered during v2, kept separate from migration

axis_record.condition: string — within-state sub-phase, or 'whole_state' when undivided
axis_record.scope: enum: whole_brain | population_subset | single_cells | whole_organism | not_applicable
axis_record.direction: enum: decreased | unchanged | increased | not_measured — A_beh and A_met only; null for A_neu

neural_submeasures._applies_to: A_neu only; null for A_beh and A_met

cell_record.coverage: enum: TESTED_POSITIVE | TESTED_NEGATIVE | NOT_TESTED — MEANING UNCHANGED FROM v1
cell_record._status_rule: UNCHANGED FROM v1. TESTED_POSITIVE + strongest_grade in {E-A,E-B,E-C,E-D} => POSITIVE; TESTED_POSITIVE + E-E/E-F => SUGGESTED; TESTED_NEGATIVE => NEGATIVE and requires negative_assay_statement; else NOT_TESTED.
cell_record.applicability: enum: APPLICABLE | QUESTIONABLE | NOT_APPLICABLE — ORTHOGONAL to coverage; never substitutes for it
roles_present: enum: PRODUCES_STATE | CONTROLS_ENTRY | MAINTAINS_STATE | PROTECTS_THROUGH_STATE | BUILDS_MACHINERY — union of roles over this cell's mechanisms
roles_tested_negative: enum as above — roles looked for in this state and NOT found; populated for scoped negatives even in a TESTED_POSITIVE cell
cell_record.ambiguity: string or null — conflicting evidence across readouts, agents, or interpretations, recorded rather than resolved
cell_record.negative_assay_statement: string or null — required when coverage is TESTED_NEGATIVE OR when roles_tested_negative is non-empty
cell_record.discriminating_experiment: string or null — what measurement would resolve an ambiguity or fill this cell

mechanism_record.label: string

roles.role: enum of the five instantiated roles
roles.basis: string — why this role and not another, in terms of what the experiment showed

mechanism_record._role_rule: Reserved roles ENABLES_EXIT and PERMISSIVE_BACKGROUND must NOT be used until a cell requires one and an amendment records it.
mechanism_record.state_polarity: enum: PROMOTES_STATE | OPPOSES_STATE | STRUCTURE_ONLY | CONTEXT_DEPENDENT | UNDETERMINED — DERIVED AND SECONDARY; must be computable from the perturbation records alone

chain.inferred: boolean — inferred steps score no cell and carry no grade

perturbation_record.manipulation: enum: loss_of_function | gain_of_function | ablation | optogenetic_activation | optogenetic_inhibition | pharmacological_block | pharmacological_activation | expression_change | environmental | other
perturbation_record.agent: string or null — specific drug where the state is drug-induced

observed_effect.state_structure: enum: increase | decrease | unchanged | not_reported — plus detail in other

perturbation_record.context_dependence: enum: none_reported | dose_dependent | timing_dependent | readout_dependent | cell_type_dependent
perturbation_record.statement: string — REQUIRED. The experimental result in the source's own terms. Governs if the compact fields disagree.

row_summary.n_distinct_sources: integer — distinct citation_ids across all populated cells
row_summary._reporting_rule: Every proportion is reported over coverage_denominator, never over 12. Role counts are descriptive tallies and are NOT an enrichment statistic; prohibition 1 still binds.

forbidden_operations: any enrichment statistic over cells or over roles
any count reported against 12 rather than coverage_denominator
aggregating A_beh, A_neu, A_met into a single value
aggregating the three A_neu sub-measures into a single neural direction
recording rate_amplitude:decrease when the experiment measured correlation, dimensionality or spectral content
assigning state_polarity from a mechanism's name or from expectation rather than from its perturbation records
using reserved roles ENABLES_EXIT or PERMISSIVE_BACKGROUND without an amendment
scoring a cell from an inferred chain step, from orthology, or from literature co-occurrence
treating NOT_TESTED as NEGATIVE, or NOT_APPLICABLE as either
converting CeNGEN or any expression evidence into TESTED_POSITIVE
